capital.evidence_quote: Andorra la Vella is the capital of the Principality of Andorra, the highest capital city in Europe

currency.evidence_quote: The Euro is the official legal tender of Andorra under monetary agreement with the European Union

timezone.evidence_quote: Andorra observes Central European Time UTC+1 and Central European Summer Time UTC+2

voltage.evidence_quote: Low-voltage electrical distribution in Andorra is standardized at 230V 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Electrical network frequency in Andorra operates continuously at 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Power plugs in Andorra conform to European two-pin Type C and Schuko Type F sockets

police.evidence_quote: Dial 110 for emergency police services across the Principality of Andorra

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 116 for medical emergencies and hospital ambulance dispatch

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 118 for mountain rescue and fire brigades throughout Andorra

general.evidence_quote: 112 operates as the unified emergency number coordinating police, medical, and mountain rescue

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Andorra dünyanın en güvenli ülkelerindendir; kış aylarında kar lastiği/zincir zorunluluğuna dikkat edilmelidir.
advisory_headline.en: Andorra is exceptionally safe; in winter, snow chains or winter tires are legally required on mountain passes.
advisory_headline.de: Andorra ist eines der sichersten Länder der Welt; im Winter gilt Winterreifen- bzw. Schneekettenpflicht.
advisory_headline.ru: Андорра — одна из самых безопасных стран мира; зимой обязательно наличие зимней резины или цепей.
advisory_headline.es: Andorra es sumamente segura; en invierno es obligatorio el uso de cadenas o neumáticos de nieve.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Andorra reach approximately 94.6 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in Andorra measure 215.2 Mbps nationwide

esim_sim_notes.value: WARNING: Andorra is NOT in the EU; EU 'Roam Like at Home' does NOT apply, and standard roaming charges can be exorbitant! Connect to public Wi-Fi or purchase an Andorra Telecom tourist eSIM before crossing the border.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Andorra is excluded from EU roaming regulations; data roaming incurs non-EU rates

tr.conditions: Andorra kendi vizesini aramaz, ancak ülkeye sadece İspanya veya Fransa üzerinden girilebilir. Türk umuma mahsus pasaport hamillerinin ÇOK GİRİŞLİ Schengen vizesine sahip olması şarttır (Yeşil pasaporta vizesiz).

us.conditions: Andorra does not require any visa, but travelers must meet Schengen entry requirements for France or Spain.

source.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Andorra

de.conditions: German and EU citizens enter Andorra using a valid national ID card or passport via France or Spain.

source.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Andorra

gb.conditions: British passport holders enter visa-free via France or Spain; a multiple-entry Schengen allowance is recommended.

ru.conditions: Для въезда в Андорру гражданам РФ требуется многократная шенгенская виза для транзита через Францию или Испанию.

dos.title: Turn off mobile data roaming before entering Andorra!
dos.description: Andorra is NOT in the EU; mobile networks charge steep non-EU roaming rates ($10+/MB). Use Wi-Fi or a local SIM.

dos.title: Declare duty-free goods at customs borders
dos.description: French and Spanish customs strictly inspect vehicles leaving Andorra for alcohol, tobacco, and luxury electronics limits.

dos.title: Equip your car with snow chains in winter
dos.description: Police turn back or fine motorists without snow chains or winter tires during snowy mountain pass conditions.

donts.title: Don't attempt entry with a single-entry Schengen visa
donts.description: Leaving Spain or France for Andorra consumes one Schengen entry; returning to Spain requires a second entry.

donts.title: Don't exceed duty-free allowances
donts.description: Duty-free thresholds (e.g. 1.5L spirits, 300 cigarettes) are strictly enforced by Guardia Civil and French Douane.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping 5-10% is customary in sit-down mountain chalets and restaurants in Andorra la Vella for good service.
